idea.heading: Meet the signs
idea.text: These three signs tell you how two numbers compare.
idea.tip: The pointy end points at the smaller number.

steps.heading: Let's compare 34 and 99.
steps.text: Each tall stick is a ten. Each little cube is a one.

steps.heading: 3 tens is less than 9 tens.
steps.text: When the tens are different, the tens decide.

steps.heading: So 34 is less than 99.
steps.text: The pointy end points at the smaller number.

afterWrong.tip: Count the tens first. If the tens are the same, look at the ones.

steps.heading: Let's try smaller numbers: 7 and 12.
steps.text: 12 has 1 ten. 7 has no tens at all, just ones.

steps.heading: 7 is less than 12.
steps.text: No tens is less than 1 ten.
